_instructions: Milestone 10. Copy this file to eval/rpa_measurements.json and fill it in
while following eval/rpa_protocol.md. Leave a field null until you have
actually measured it - the harness prints 'not measured' rather than
inventing a number, and a half-filled file is fine.
Times are in seconds. Record them with a stopwatch, not an estimate.

operator._note: e.g. 'first time using Power Automate Desktop' or '2 years'. Skill is the biggest confound in this comparison and has to be stated.

tool._note: Power Automate Desktop is free on Windows 11 and is the suggested choice; UiPath Community Edition also works.

setup._note_human: Time the person spends demonstrating/recording, measured the SAME way for both systems: from starting the recording to finishing the last demonstrated row.
setup._note_config: Everything after the recording that is needed before the first row can run: selector fixes, loop setup, variable wiring, Excel connection.
setup._note_first_row: From opening the tool with nothing configured, to one row correctly filled AND visually verified in the portal.

baseline_run._note: Run the finished automation over all 50 rows of v0_base and count how many landed correctly.

after_ui_change._note: Apply the SAME automation, with no re-recording and no edits, to each variant. Record what happens.

v1_reordered._outcome_values: one of: 'ran correctly', 'ran but wrong fields', 'crashed', 'selector not found'

reconfiguration._note: For each variant that broke, time how long it takes to get it working again.
